description: Solution concentration converter — Convert one solution concentration into every common unit: molarity (M, mM, uM), molality (mol/kg), mass percent (w/w), percent w/v, ppm and ppb by mass, mg/L, g/L, mole fraction and mol%. Give value + from unit + solute formula (molar mass computed from IUPAC weights) or mw=, and density= of the solution in g/mL (assumed 1.000 with a warning if omitted). Optional solvent= formula or solvent_mw= (default water). Returns grams and moles per liter of solution plus all conversions. Offline, instant. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: chem_concentration
